speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether HDB has an initiative that allows single or estranged persons to live alone instead of requiring a co-tenant for HDB rental flats; and (b) if so, whether the Ministry can provide an update on this initiative.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: For instance, HDB has been building new rental flats with high partitions to provide more privacy and these have been well-received.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: HDB will continue to include partitions in new rental flats, where feasible, and install them in existing flats at tenants’ request.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Ms Denise Phua, a short clarification because we are ending Question Time soon.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: It is not uncommon for Members of Parliament to receive requests to live alone or to transfer to another flat and they are usually frustrated tenants who find it very hard to get along with their assigned co-tenants.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: So, while I know it is costly to have only one tenant live in a whole flat, are there any other models also, beyond the partitions, that will decrease tensions of strangers living together, for example, reducing co-living spaces with shared facilities and so forth?

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I am just looking at other models that are a bit more out of the box and not so traditional.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Nevertheless, as I shared in my answer, we will continue to explore new models and ways to improve the lived experiences of singles in public rental flats.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: In fact, we are looking at alternative typologies and will share more details soon.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
